study: Check whether computing frozen Transformer encoder memory once per graph leaves generated token IDs invariant relative to frozen nn.Transformer.forward called every greedy decoding step.
implementation_description: Independent diagnostic reconstruction of frozen 424387-parameter architecture. Original: at each output step, recompute full src+tgt transformer. Probe: compute frozen net.transformer.encoder(net._embed(src)) once, then use net.transformer.decoder(net._embed(tgt), memory) and the same output head with the same masks and greedy argmax. Frozen model suite file NOT altered.

environment.hardware: Local diagnostic CPU, not matched to GitHub hosted runner

synthetic_short_horizon.notes: Per-synthetic-case timing includes variable warmup and source lengths; not host-equivalent production benchmarks.

synthetic_full_horizon.input: Two invented JSON triples, no real WebNLG data
